==Acquisition==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
*[[Factions]]
**[[Blade Ancient Syu-Shai]] ([[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]]) (requires a party member to be carrying a [[Proof of Triumph]])

Note that as a [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only]] skill, [[Elite Skill Tome|Elite Skill Tomes]] cannot be used to learn this skill.

==Notes==
*This skill will increase [[Axe Mastery]], [[Dagger Mastery]], [[Hammer Mastery]], [[Marksmanship]], [[Scythe Mastery]], [[Spear Mastery]] and [[Swordsmanship]] regardless of the secondary profession selected and display them in the attributes list while the effect is active.
*Attributes are still capped at rank 20, see [[Attribute]] for more details.

== See also ==
* [[Weapon swap]]
* [[Weapon set]]

==Trivia==
*This skill uses the same icon as the ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' [[gw2:Spellbreaker|Spellbreaker]] skill [[gw2:Imminent Threat|Imminent Threat]].
*The skill's name refers to the seven physical damage martial weapons in the game: [[Sword]], [[Axe]], [[Hammer]], [[Bow]], [[Dagger]], [[Scythe]], [[Spear]].
*Added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20200422|22nd April 2020 update]] as part of the 15th [[Anniversary Celebration]].
